chatConnect.title: Ebda Chat
chatConnect.intro: Reply to your customers on WhatsApp from one inbox.
chatConnect.whatItDoes: Connecting only creates your Ebda Chat workspace. There is no charge, no plan change, and no message is sent to anyone.
chatConnect.connectedBody: Your store is connected to Ebda Chat.
chatConnect.toastBody: Your Ebda Chat workspace is ready.
chatConnect.notIncluded: Your plan does not include Ebda Chat. Upgrade your plan to connect it.
chatConnect.errRole: Only the store owner or a store admin can connect Ebda Chat. Ask the owner to do it.
chatConnect.errMfa: Turn on two-step verification for your account before connecting Ebda Chat.
chatConnect.errSession: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
chatConnect.errNetwork: No connection right now. Check your internet and try again.
chatConnect.errLoad: We could not check whether Ebda Chat is connected. Try again.
chatConnect.errGeneric: Ebda Chat could not be connected. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
